lines.head: One team email, many people
lines.sub: A second person with the same email was blocked as a duplicate.
lines.text: E4-1. Many customers use one email for a whole team, like a QC inbox. Adding a second person from that team was blocked as a duplicate.
lines.say: E four one. Many customers use one email for a whole team, like a QC inbox. Adding a second person from that team was blocked as a duplicate.

lines.head: New Shared / Generic Email tick box
lines.sub: When ticked, people are identified by account, mobile and name.
lines.text: Now, leads and contacts have a Shared / Generic Email tick box. When it's ticked, people are identified by their account, mobile number and name instead.
lines.say: Now, leads and contacts have a Shared Generic Email tick box. When it's ticked, people are identified by their account, mobile number and name instead.

lines.head: Converting a shared-email lead
lines.sub: No one matches this mobile and name, so a new contact is created.
lines.text: Here, a lead with the box ticked is converted. Nobody on the account has the same mobile and name, so a new contact is created.
lines.say: Here, a lead with the box ticked is converted. Nobody on the account has the same mobile and name, so a new contact is created.

lines.head: Team members save side by side
lines.sub: The same person, with the same name and mobile, is still caught.
lines.text: Several people from one team can now share an email, while real duplicates are still caught.
lines.say: Several people from one team can now share an email, while real duplicates are still caught.
